status: qualified source; U5 cleanup and live admission remain gated

configuration.selection: Root-protected configuration and hash-pinned template only; no worker body or environment selection.
configuration.hash_domains: Structural JSON decoder offsets retain every pinned template top-level raw value. Root-authored metadata is encoded separately. This preserves Go typed policy RawMessage pricing exponent, key order and escapes.
configuration.grant_scope: Actual sha(grant) is distinct from saved wallet scope digest. Allowance remains unchanged. Root scope expiry is minimum of grant, lease, control, allowance and route deadlines; output limit comes from protected launch contract and cannot exceed allowance or16384.

descriptors.bootstrap: Root-owned sealed memfd1..262144 bytes; four seals; exact raw-byte config hash.
descriptors.cold_ready: Distinct Root-owned write pipe, separate from pre-exec ready/gate. Complete single newline JSON record plus EOF, at most4096 bytes, within preparation/Root deadline.
descriptors.helper_allowlist: Socket/program/gate/pre-exec-ready plus bootstrap/cold-ready descriptors; bootstrap forwards exact allowlist and exec adds --bootstrap-fd/--cold-ready-fd.
descriptors.namespace: Exact same-number UID maps Root0/gateway/broker/capture; exact GID maps Root0/gateway/broker. Strict service UID comparisons and namespace ownerRoot0 retained; overflow/extra identities rejected.
descriptors.lifecycle: Consumed start intent precedes guard/bind/spawn. Existing private launch is now called by public authenticated start before worker creation. Returned child retained in gateway_children. Readiness binds config/launch/grant/scope/review/PID/ticks/UID/socket, rechecks namespace/executable/current authority. Observe checks gateway lifetime; revoke fences and joins; close cannot succeed while handed socket cleanup remains unqualified. Reconcile never reports not_started after gateway intent.

contract.lifetime_fix: Retain returned gateway; revalidate retained process/PID/launch/peer and frozen deadline immediately before Docker create/start and while observing running workers; revoke/fence on loss.

native.task: Frozen Root gateway lifetime fix verification only

import os,ctypes,subprocess,sys,json
root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.
if len(sys.argv)>2 and sys.argv[2]=='probe-only':os._exit(0)
os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)

pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.

os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)

pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0

libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')

os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.

os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')

subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)

pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')

os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)

 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.

root=sys.argv[1]
assert os.uname().machine=='x86_64'
assert os.stat('/proc/self/ns/mnt').st_ino != os.stat('/proc/1/ns/mnt').st_ino
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--make-rprivate','/'],check=True)
python_identity=os.stat(root+'/usr/bin/python3.13')
base_identity=os.stat(root+sys.argv[3]);gw_identity=os.stat(root+'/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw')
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','--rbind',root,root],check=True)
subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/mount','-t','proc','proc',root+'/proc'],check=True)
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 os.chroot(root);os.chdir('/')
 libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True);rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000)
 error=ctypes.get_errno();print(json.dumps({'chroot_userns_result':rc,'errno':error}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==-1 and error==1 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.mkdir(root+'/.old-root',0o755)
libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
assert libc.syscall(155,root.encode(),(root+'/.old-root').encode())==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.chdir('/')
assert libc.umount2(b'/.old-root',2)==0,ctypes.get_errno()
os.rmdir('/.old-root')
current_python=os.stat('/usr/bin/python3.13');assert (current_python.st_dev,current_python.st_ino)==(python_identity.st_dev,python_identity.st_ino)
for path,expected in [(sys.argv[3],base_identity),('/var/lib/sfactory-harness/gw',gw_identity)]:
 actual=os.stat(path);assert (actual.st_dev,actual.st_ino)==(expected.st_dev,expected.st_ino)
assert int(open('/proc/self/stat').read().split(' ',1)[0])==os.getpid()
assert not os.path.exists('/.old-root') and not os.path.exists('/assets')
pid=os.fork()
if pid==0:
 rc=libc.unshare(0x10000000);print(json.dumps({'pivot_userns_result':rc,'errno':ctypes.get_errno()}),flush=True);os._exit(0 if rc==0 else 1)
_,status=os.waitpid(pid,0);assert status==0
os.environ.clear();os.environ['DBUS_SYSTEM_BUS_ADDRESS']='unix:path=/run/systemd/private'
# Probe-only mode exits before authority, services or gateway side effects.

os.execve('/usr/bin/python3.13',['/usr/bin/python3.13','-I','-B',sys.argv[2],*sys.argv[3:]],os.environ)

import os,json,subprocess,hashlib,time
from pathlib import Path

assert record['exit_code']==-15
live=[]
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdecimal():continue
 try:
  raw=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes()
  if str(stage).encode() in raw and p.name!=str(os.getpid()):
   live.append({'pid':int(p.name),'ticks':(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19],'exe':os.readlink(p/'exe')})
 except (OSError,ValueError,IndexError):pass
print(json.dumps({'owned_stage_live_references':live}),flush=True)
assert not live
assert os.statvfs('/').f_bavail*os.statvfs('/').f_frsize>=8*1024**3
cmd=list(record['command']);cmd[cmd.index('-o')+1]=str(stage/'public-builder-v2.test')
assert not (stage/'public-builder-v2.test').exists()
receipt={'stage':str(stage),'previous_state_preserved':str(state),'command':cmd,'state':'running'}
with (stage/'build-resume.log').open('x') as out:
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=stage/'source/transports',env=record['environment'],stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
 receipt.update(pid=p.pid,ticks=Path('/proc/'+str(p.pid)+'/stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]);Path('/tmp/public-root-build-resume-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt));print(json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)

 while p.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<deadline:

  os.killpg(p.pid,15)
 rc=p.wait(timeout=15)
